about_the_game:
FERAN is a multiplayer, open-world survival game set in a brutal post-apocalyptic landscape teeming with undead and wild animals.

Civilization collapsed under a misterious outbreak that turned millions into relentless zombies, only scattered survivors remain. You are one of them.

Feran is what the survivors now call the Earth — a name born from the ashes of collapse. Explore abandoned cities, forests, and underground facilities to survive alone or with friends.

  • Surviving – Gather food, medicines and water. Plant and grow your own food or hunt a dozen unique wild animals to survive.

  • Quest – Meet several NPCs who buy and sell goods and offer quest jobs for rewards.

  • Drive – Get around the world with cars or tracks. Learn the recipes, customize and refuel your own vehicles.

  • Build – Fortify your own home, construct facilities and design your own defence system with traps, electric power and automated doors to defend yourself against zombies and raiders.

  • Crafting – Find schematics to learn new recipes to repair weapons, cook food and handcraft clothes and armour.

  • Weather events – a season inspired day cycle with random atmospheric events will effect gameplay, like body temperature dropping in winter and walking on slippery surface on icy roads.

  • Combat - a modular weapon system which allows to add weapons accessories like scopes, silencers and magazines to your weapons. Use bandages to stop bleeding and sleep to heal your wounds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.8 Ghz Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB Dedicated Memory
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® Compatible
  • Additional Notes: These are just ballpark figures, more detailed requirement will be added as the game development continues
